description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, owners, extents, and property rights. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
